interview.question: Provide ten independently attributable original-time decisions and exceptions, not one shared approval. D01.01: identify the approved internal/external application-delivery standard, workload-owned spoke ingress, regional Application Gateway v2/WAF versus global Front Door/WAF and origin restriction, including justified protocol/partner alternatives. D01.02: explicitly designate hubs/spokes and justify traditional topology against flexibility, traffic/isolation/transit and managed alternatives; names and peering count do not prove purpose. D01.03: identify required regions and complete regional connectivity/DNS/identity/management readiness, physical failure domains and exercised DR; location labels are not readiness. D01.04: bind the designated hub to required shared ER/VPN/firewall or supported partner NVA and conditional DNS services, ownership and effective inspection; do not centralize shared L7 workload ingress. D01.06: if partner technology applies, identify exact vendor/version/supported design and evidence for HA, convergence, symmetry/SNAT, performance and Azure compatibility; generic Azure patterns are not vendor approval. D01.07: determine whether ER/S2S VPN transit is actually required, establish Route Server VNet attachment and explicit branch exchange, same-VNet gateways and active-active VPN ASN65515/route-based non-Basic requirements; VPN BGP is not required, P2S and ER-to-ER transit are excluded, effective routes/failover need separate evidence. D01.08: acknowledge immutable /27 wording versus current linked /26-or-larger quickstart and older provider /27 guidance; approve a dedicated RouteServerSubnet with current source-qualified capacity and NSG/UDR restrictions, not a name-only check. D01.09: designate actual regional hubs and approve both directional global peerings/alternative interregional design, nontransitivity, Basic Load Balancer restrictions and required inspection without unintended bypass; unequal regions do not prove global hub transit. D01.10: show actual Network Insights topology/health/metrics visibility, required connectivity/traffic/alerts, ingestion/freshness, ownership and response with redacted evidence; built-in views need no configuration and no test/probe is authorized here. D01.11: reconcile immutable400/500/1000 wording with current650 peerings/VNet and source-specific Route Server/ER direction/family/SKU limits; establish authorized current quotas and complete regional spokes/peerings/advertised-prefix populations, summarization and growth/exception plan, rather than counting selected records.
